description: This bar chart illustrates the Inference Time (in minutes) for four different methods: Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, and DPO, across two distinct models, Marco-01-7B and QwQ-32B-Preview. The horizontal axis displays the method names—Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, and DPO—and is labeled “Inference Time (minute)”. The vertical axis represents the value scale, ranging from 0 to 7 with a tick interval of 1, and is not explicitly labeled but represents time in minutes. For the Marco-01-7B model, the bars are stacked, with Baseline represented in light green, Fast-Solving Prompt in yellow, SFT in orange, and DPO in blue. The Baseline bar reaches approximately 0.2 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt reaches approximately 0.8 minutes, SFT reaches approximately 1.5 minutes, and DPO reaches approximately 2.2 minutes. For the QwQ-32B-Preview model, the bars are also stacked using the same color scheme. The Baseline bar reaches approximately 1.2 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt reaches approximately 3.2 minutes, SFT reaches approximately 4.8 minutes, and DPO reaches approximately 6.5 minutes. The bars are arranged alphabetically by method name within each model. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
